title: Flock Audit Logs Dunwoody October - December 2024

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Georgia Open Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

Copies of all audit logs, search logs, or usage reports related to your agency's use of Flock "ALPR" systems for the period October 1, 2024 through December 31, 2024. This includes but is not limited to the "Organization Audit" and "Network Audit" logs available in the Flock software's "Insights" section, showing records of license plate searches performed by agency personnel, timestamps of searches, user identification information (names, badge numbers, or user IDs), and any associated case numbers or investigation references.

Please provide records in their original electronic format (CSV, Excel, or similar).

To the extent any portion of these records is claimed exempt under the Open Records Act, I request that the exemption be applied at the field or column level rather than by withholding entire logs, consistent with the segregability requirement of O.C.G.A. § 50-18-71(b)(1)(A). If a specific field (such as the free-text search justification field) is withheld, please identify which field and the specific statutory basis for withholding it.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 3 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Jason Hunyar

title: Real-Time Crime Center (RTCC) Policy, Contracts, and Data-Sharing Records

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Texas Public Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

Held by the City of Beaumont and the Beaumont Police Department regarding the Real-Time Crime Center (RTCC), the Fusus platform, and any integrated camera or license-plate-reader (LPR) system:

1. The current written policy, general order, standard operating procedure, or applicable chapter of the department's policy manual governing the RTCC, the Fusus platform, and any integrated camera or LPR system — including provisions on data retention periods, access authorization, and acceptable/prohibited use.

2. Any records retention schedule for RTCC/Fusus video and LPR data submitted to or approved by the Texas State Library and Archives Commission.

3. All current contracts, licenses, statements of work, renewals, and invoices between the City of Beaumont or BPD and Fusus/Axon, or any other RTCC camera-integration or LPR vendor.

4. All memoranda of understanding or data-sharing agreements between BPD and any other entity regarding access to RTCC or LPR data, including but not limited to: Beaumont Independent School District, Lamar University, Lamar Institute of Technology, the Port of Beaumont, any Orange, Hardin, or Jefferson County agency, the El Paso Sheriff's Office, any Alabama, Houston, or Louisiana law-enforcement agency, the relevant Texas fusion center, Texas DPS, and any federal agency (FBI, ICE, CBP, DHS, ATF, USPIS).

5. Any grant application, award, or reporting documents — including any Homeland Security grant referenced in connection with regional RTCC expansion — that describe the scope, funding, or partner agencies of the program.

If any portion of these records is withheld under a Chapter 552 exception, I request that the City identify the specific exception claimed for each withheld record, consistent with its obligation to seek a ruling from the Attorney General's Open Records Division within 10 business days when raising an exception (§552.301).

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

No Known Number
